changes: The dev failures were mostly hard problems where the solver submitted after the public samples passed, skipping brute-force comparison, timing, and impossibility checks (one arc182-d failure printed a number where -1 was expected). I rewrote the solver.md checklist to require listing every impossibility condition, watching parity/cycle invariants and special small parameters, and running brute-force plus timing in a single combined run_python call before submitting. I also added a `stress-testing` skill with a reusable template for brute-force comparison, output checking, edge-case generation, and timeout-guarded timing. I fixed an unquoted-colon YAML error in the skill frontmatter, and validate() now passes. A trial on lcb-arc182-d, which failed before, now passes, though that is one sample and not a measure of the rate.
